errors.evidence: The red line, representing 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', starts at approximately 35.15 on the y-axis when S=1, not 35.5.
The red line, representing 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', ends at approximately 35.8 on the y-axis when S=10, not 35.7.
The green line, representing 'DPR w/ document expansion', begins at approximately 34.8 on the y-axis when S=1, not 34.7.
The green line for 'DPR w/ document expansion' remains stable in the range of approximately 34.8 to 34.9; it never reaches the value of 35.0.
The blue line for 'DPR w/ asymmetric expansion' does not peak at S=3. It has a local minimum at S=3 (approx. 34.75) and its main peak is at S=5 with a value of approximately 35.0, not 35.1.
The blue line for 'DPR w/ asymmetric expansion' ends at approximately 34.4 on the y-axis when S=10, not 34.3.
